source: Sivasubramanian & Fasel (2015) JFM 768:175-218, sharp 7-deg cone Mach 6 (BAM6QT); second-mode most-amplified frequency band ~220-280 kHz and peak linear N~7-8 at end of cone (cross-checked vs BAM6QT design review arXiv:2509.10411 and Stetson sharp-cone N~7 at transition)

conditions.geometry: sharp cone, 7 deg half-angle, zero incidence (Mangler path)
conditions.formulation: spatial 2nd mode (L* scale, lambda_mu_ratio=1.2), cone Mangler N=int 6 sigma_L dR_eq
conditions.edge_provenance: Taylor-Maccoll solve (7 deg, M_inf=6, gamma=1.4); shock angle beta=11.94 deg; cross-check: design review reports cone M_e~5.5 / TM M_e~5.6 for a 5-deg cone, consistent with our 5.36 for a larger 7-deg cone
conditions.transverse_curvature: OMITTED (Mangler scope); valid since delta << r_local = s*sin(7deg) over s=120-520 mm window

quantity: second-mode peak-N frequency (kHz) and peak linear N-factor on sharp cone
verdict_reason: FIRST exercise of the pyMack sharp-cone Mangler path (pymack.cone) against external Mach-6 sharp-cone second-mode data. Edge state from a Taylor-Maccoll solve (M_e=5.356, T_e=63.78 K, U_e=857.5 m/s) validated against the BAM6QT design review (cone M_e~5.5, TM~5.6 for a 5-deg cone; our 7-deg gives 5.36 - physically consistent). Mean flow: isothermal Tw=300 K Sutherland CompressibleBlasiusProfile; spatial second mode via solve_spatial (L*, lambda_mu_ratio=1.2, c_r~0.90); N integrated with cone_n_factor (ds=6 L*_eq dR_eq). pyMack peak-N N=7.06 vs benchmark N~7-8 at end of cone => 0.8% from N=7, 5.9% from the 7.5 midpoint - genuinely strong agreement on N magnitude. pyMack peak-N frequency 210 kHz sits at the LOWER edge of the documented 220-280 kHz most-amplified band (4.5% from 220 kHz, 16% from the 250 kHz midpoint); the amplified band itself (N>4 spanning 180-330 kHz) brackets the benchmark band well. Verdict = acceptable rather than agrees because (i) the absolute N is sensitive to the chosen s=120-520 mm window and (ii) the peak-N frequency lands at the band edge. No topology/mode mismatch (clean discrete second mode, single growth lobe, monotone N). Transverse-curvature terms omitted per Mangler scope (delta<<r_local holds on this window).

Edge state from taylor_maccoll_edge_state.py. Single-thread BLAS.
